entry.title: Illustrating a year of turmoil inside Iran

media:group.media:title: Illustrating a year of turmoil inside Iran
media:group.media:description:
On this week’s episode of On Assignment, host Jonah Green speaks with Reuters correspondent John Davison about Under Fire, a graphic memoir by Reuters that tells the story of one Iranian woman through a year of protests, war and a tenuous ceasefire. Davison describes how he reported it over 11 months, how the team verified meticulous details with illustrator Adolfo Arranz, and what daily life looked like inside Iran during the conflict.
